title: 印尼市场信心下滑：市场参与者为何担忧
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Fried food. What's not to love? It's delicious, but also generally bad for you.
segments.zh: 油炸食品，谁能不爱？美味，但通常不健康。

segments.en: And curiously, the same could be said of some stocks in Indonesia. In fact, they're often called deep fried stocks.
segments.zh: 奇怪的是，印尼的一些权益资产也是如此，常被称为“油炸权益资产”。

segments.en: Well, they may look tasty on the outside. Inside, they're really not that healthy.
segments.zh: 外表诱人，内里却并不健康。

segments.en: Unhealthy stocks are just one of the reasons investors have become wary of Indonesia's stock market.
segments.zh: 不健康的权益资产只是市场参与者对印尼市场谨慎的原因之一。

segments.en: Which until recently was the biggest in Southeast Asia.
segments.zh: 直到最近，它还是东南亚最大的市场。

segments.en: And concerns are growing over the country's potential for growth more broadly.
segments.zh: 人们对印尼整体增长潜力的担忧也在加剧。

segments.en: Just three to four years ago, it was an investor's stalling. There was so much bust.
segments.zh: 就在三四年前，它还是市场参与者的宠儿，充满活力。

segments.en: It's one of the fastest growing economies in the world. At $1.5 trillion, Indonesia's GDP is more than Singapore's anti-lens combined.
segments.zh: 它是全球增长最快的经济体之一，GDP达1.5万亿美元，超过新加坡和马来西亚之和。

segments.en: Within Southeast Asia itself, Indonesia is the largest economy.
segments.zh: 在东南亚，印尼是最大的经济体。

segments.en: Indonesia wants to be on the world stage. It wants to grow faster and it has all the ingredients for it.
segments.zh: 印尼希望登上世界舞台，加速增长，它具备所有条件。

segments.en: But fear of corruption and policing missteps, both in markets and government, is putting this path at risk.
segments.zh: 但对腐败和市场监管失误的担忧，正使这一路径面临风险。

segments.en: Moodies, wands, Indonesia's tighter export controls may spook investors.
segments.zh: 穆迪警告，印尼更严格的出口管制可能吓跑市场参与者。

segments.en: The Indonesia market here down about 19% in the past year.
segments.zh: 印尼市场过去一年下跌约19%。

segments.en: Indonesia's currency, the Repia, has fallen to all time lows against the US dollar in 2026.
segments.zh: 印尼盾兑美元汇率在2026年跌至历史新低。
